scope.folders: Persistent workspace classification, never a Storage path or permission grant
scope.identity: Current server-validated USER JWT plus active selected workspace and current membership on every read/command

invariants: Folder and document always belong to the same authorized workspace; no actor/workspace/role/path/object_ref is accepted from input.
Classification cannot alter canonical document customer/contract/service/line/case/opportunity ancestry or broaden document read authorization.
No browser/localStorage truth and no physical object move/reupload.
Folder structure and assignments are transactional, forced-RLS, closed RPC/DTO, CAS, idempotent command and audit.
Structure changes serialize within the workspace before cycle/depth checks; simultaneous reverse moves cannot both create a cycle.
Assignment state persists with a monotonic classification_version even when folder_id becomes null, preventing ABA reset.
Existing document.library.v2 and all legacy metadata/commands remain unchanged; additive v3 only after agreement.
Feature gates default OFF in HTTP and DB; no remote migration or hosted flag change.

Classification and folder archive share the same workspace serialization boundary; after acquiring it, recheck folder active status, assignments, ancestry and current authorization within the transaction. They cannot both commit a dangling assignment into an archived folder.
Moving a folder validates maximum resulting depth of its entire subtree, including archived descendants, under the same workspace serialization; checking only the moved node is insufficient.

folder.customer_context: Not part of initial D2. Customer filters continue to derive exclusively from canonical document ancestry.

names.normalization: NFC and trim; active sibling duplicate equivalence must have an exact deterministic DB/JS policy agreed by W1 before implementation
names.privacy: Names are authorized metadata for owner/admin, not original filenames; no global.search/assistant indexing or diagnostic logging

assignment.document_version: Existing document.version remains a separate metadata CAS; classification command checks both current versions

model.archive_policy: Initial bounded proposal: only leaf folders with zero child folders of any status and zero assigned documents of any status. Reject with conflict, never implicitly reparent/delete documents. Restore requires active ancestor chain, depth and active-name uniqueness.
model.migration: One new forward-only CLI-generated migration after agreement; no canonical SQL file is created by this proposal. Exact composed manifests/hashes/blobs must distinguish base87+D1 from hosted base87+Storage88.

output: exact authorized sibling count when proved
folder_list.ordering: Deterministic approved normalized name + UUID, agreed with W1

library_v3.preserves: Approved v2 metadata/search/filter/created-order/count/keyset and current ancestry authorization
library_v3.classification_selector: Exactly one of {kind:all}, {kind:unclassified}, {kind:folder,id:UUID}; filter before count/limit
library_v3.proposed_http_dispatch: /api/document/library/v3/queries only; existing /api/document/library/v2/queries and repository.documentLibrary remain v2 unchanged
library_v3.proposed_rpc_dispatch: New document_library_v3_list signature; never redefine document_library_v2_list or route v2 input to v3 by a mutable flag
library_v3.proposed_repository_dispatch: Add distinct documentLibraryV3 typed consumer only after W1 agreement; no overload that silently changes v2 DTO/meaning
library_v3.enablement: Separate default-OFF D2 gate plus accepted D1 gate; unavailable/denied cannot fall back to complete empty. Exact flag/config inventory needs W5 agreement before code.

reads.cursors: Opaque encrypted, domain separated, expiring; bind actor/workspace/current membership revision/query/filter/sort/limit/parent/classification. No count or folder label leakage from foreign or stale cursors.

common: exact retry is one committed effect; changed input with same command_id conflicts
commands.receipt: Versioned command identity/resource/revisions only; receipt does not replace a fresh authorized readback.
commands.audit: Record registered action, tenant/actor/resource/command identity and revision changes; no filename/name/body/path/token/URL in application diagnostics.

expected_acceptance.case: Owner/admin create root/subfolder and classify document through UI; reload preserves IDs/hierarchy/classification
Tenant A document to tenant B folder and foreign parent/get/search/cursor: denied, exact state unchanged, no foreign labels/counts
A→B→C hierarchy rejects moving A under C; simultaneous reverse-parent moves serialize and cannot both form a cycle
Concurrent rename with the same expected_version yields one effect and a conflict; exact command replay adds no audit/effect
Classification A→null→A monotonically increments classification_version; old CAS cannot succeed after ABA
Archive assigned/nonleaf folder rejects without document deletion/move; empty leaf archive/restore persists and enforces parent/name policy
More than100 siblings and123 documents support complete cursor pages/all/unclassified/folder plus combined canonical customer/target filters
Member/viewer/anon/service_role gain no folder/library privileges; direct tables and unknown API input denied
Same valid JWT after membership suspension denies read/command and retires rows, cursors and controls
Lost committed response freezes exact classification/rename command intent; retry has one effect and authorized readback
Late folder/list/assignment responses after query, customer, role or workspace change cannot repopulate stale UI
390/768/1440 tree/breadcrumbs/forms/actions loaded; focus/Tab/ShiftTab/Escape/scroll and no overflow
Actual Storage pause leaves folder and metadata listing usable; restore and own stack teardown verified
D2 gate OFF preserves unchanged legacy customer/document writes, v2 bank and exact old migration-profile rejection

Race classify against empty-leaf archive using independent connections/barrier: serialization and transactional rechecks prevent both commits from leaving an assignment in an archived folder; exact losing state/audit unchanged
Move a valid parent whose descendants would exceed depth8: reject even when the moved node alone is within limit; concurrent subtree changes cannot bypass the serialized maximum-depth check
